audit.whatIsWrong: The lane was framed around 'his Torment DoT' and 'his Demonflare pull'. Swain has neither of those as described.
audit.why: His E is Nevermove (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, 850 range): a wave that travels out and ROOTS on the way back, after which he may pull the rooted target. There is no damage-over-time ability in the kit. Demonflare is the recast nova of Demonic Ascension (R, 120s, 650 range), not the ult's name and not a pull.
audit.corrected: Difficulty is the Nevermove return: the root cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight, and the safe moment to channel is after the wave has passed back through you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike said 'Voice of Light comes online to finally answer his poke with real range', under a row that gives level 6 to Swain.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's ultimate is Falling Star / The Skies Descend, a 1250-range stun on 120/110/100s — not a poke tool. Demonic Ascension is indefinite as long as he keeps draining a champion, so a single stun does not end it.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated: your stun arrives, his drain form arrives, and the drain wins that trade unless Grievous Wounds is already bought.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real interactions were absent: Nevermove's root cancels both of your channels, and your black hole executes on a percentage against a champion who permanently stacks maximum health.
audit.why: Riot's Ravenous Flock text: Soul Fragments heal him and permanently increase his maximum health. Aurelion Sol's E carries the percentHealth and execute properties — the centre executes below a health percentage, so extra max health does not push him out of range of it.
audit.corrected: State both, and pair them with the anti-heal line the item block already carries: Grievous Wounds before you commit, black hole for the health stacking, and no channel while Nevermove is in the air.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Catalogue defect 3. Real numbers: Nevermove 12s at rank 1, Vision of Empire 22s at rank 1, Death's Hand 7s at rank 1 down to 3s at rank 5, Demonic Ascension 120s, Astral Flight 22s.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around those numbers, with the Nevermove-return sequencing spelled out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aurelion Sol wins only 40.79% of 152 games here, yet both layers hand him the last two stages of the chart.
audit.why: The kit supports the scaling argument, but a 40.79% win rate does not obviously support winning two of seven stages. I could not resolve this from the kits and did not guess.
audit.corrected: Left the sides as the content layer had them (which also removes the cross-layer disagreement) and raised the question rather than moving rows on a hunch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement on rows 6 and 7: phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] read 'Aurelion Sol'. whys[4] also described you trading evenly at 6 under a Swain row.
audit.why: Rows rendering two answers, and a why arguing with its own verdict.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol with ratings and whys rewritten; whys[4] rewritten to explain why 6 is his.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, and dosFull[2].d discussed his ultimate under a title about matching roams.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

audit.whatIsWrong: Surviving PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol language: the content layer still described "Comet" / "Comet stacking", which is Comet of Legend from the old kit. The live kit has no Comet — the permanent stacking resource is Stardust (Cosmic Creator).
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/aurelionsol.json lists P Cosmic Creator, Q Breath of Light, W Astral Flight, E Singularity, R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. No ability named Comet exists. The Arcane Comet references in report[6] are the rune and are correct — only these content-layer scaling lines were wrong.
audit.corrected: "Comet"/"Comet stacking" replaced with stardust, which is the resource those sentences were actually describing.

notes: Two fabricated abilities removed. 'Torment (E)' does not exist — his E is Nevermove, a wave that roots on the RETURN and then allows a pull, 12s at rank 1, 850 range; there is no damage-over-time in the kit. 'Demonflare (R)' was used as the ultimate's name and as the source of the pull — Demonic Ascension is the ult (120s, 650 drain radius, indefinite while draining a champion), Demonflare is its recast nova, and the pull belongs to Nevermove. 'Voice of Light' is not Aurelion Sol's ultimate and appeared in three content fields. Anti-heal is genuinely correct here (Riot: Soul Fragments heal him and permanently raise his max health) and the existing item line was kept. NOT asserted: the _missing 'resistances-invalidated' rule for Ravenous Flock — Riot's text describes healing and max-health growth, not resistance-bypassing damage, so that claim was left out. Cross-layer chart disagreement fixed on rows 6 and 7, and whys[4] was rewritten to agree with its own row.
